- Comparative analysis report
- Policy recommendations white paper

# Threat Assessment Methodology Research Project

PI: Dr. Sarah Chen, Department of Political Science
Grant: NSF-SES-2024-1847

## Objective
Develop a comprehensive analytical framework for evaluating lone-actor threat assessment methodologies used by federal and state law enforcement agencies. The project examines how threat indicators are identified, evaluated, and prioritized in the context of political violence.

## Scope
- Review existing threat assessment models (TRAP-18, FBI Behavioral Analysis, JTTF protocols)
- Analyze declassified case studies of thwarted and executed attacks
- Interview current and former law enforcement analysts
- Propose improvements to existing early-warning frameworks

## Current Phase
Phase 2: Case study compilation and methodology analysis. Research assistants are compiling detailed operational profiles of historical incidents to identify common patterns and gaps in existing detection frameworks.

## Deliverables
- Annotated bibliography of threat assessment literature
- Database of 50+ coded case studies
- Comparative analysis report
- Policy recommendations white paper
